#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int N, fifty, hundred, K;
int memo[2][51][51];
long long comb[101][101];
int memo2[2][51][51][10001];

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int calc(int t, int f, int h) {
    if (f + h == 0) return 0;
    if (memo[t][f][h] != -1) return memo[t][f][h];
    if (t == 1) return 1 + (f < fifty ? calc(0, f + 1, h) : calc(0, f, h + 1));
    int res = 1000000;
    for (int i = 0; i <= f; i++) {
        if (i * 50 > K) break;
        int j = std::min((K - i * 50) / 100, h);
        int totalW = i * 50 + j * 100;
        if ((fifty - f + i > 0 && totalW > 50) || (hundred - h + j > 1 && totalW > 100) || (i == fifty && j == hundred))
            res = std::min(res, calc(1, f - i, h - j));
    }
    return memo[t][f][h] = res + 1;
}

int compute2(int t, int f, int h, int r) {
    if (r == 0 && f == 0 && h == 0) return 1;
    if (r == 0) return 0;
    if (memo2[t][f][h][r] != -1) return memo2[t][f][h][r];
    long long answer = 0;
    if (t == 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= fifty - f; i++) {
            if (i * 50 > K) break;
            for (int j = 0; j <= hundred - h; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                int sumW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                if (sumW > K) break;
                long long ways = (comb[fifty - f][i] * comb[hundred - h][j]) % MOD;
                answer = (answer + ways * compute2(0, f + i, h + j, r - 1)) % MOD;
            }
        }
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i <= f; i++) {
            if (i * 50 > K) break;
            for (int j = 0; j <= h; j++) {
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                int sumW = i * 50 + j * 100;
                if (sumW > K) break;
                long long ways = (comb[f][i] * comb[h][j]) % MOD;
                answer = (answer + ways * compute2(1, f - i, h - j, r - 1)) % MOD;
            }
        }
    }
    return memo2[t][f][h][r] = (int)answer;
}

long long nCk(int n, int k) {
    if (n < k) return 0;
    if (k == 0 || n == k) return 1;
    if (comb[n][k] != -1) return comb[n][k];
    if (n - k < k) return comb[n][k] = nCk(n, n - k);
    long long res = ((long long)n * nCk(n - 1, k - 1)) % MOD;
    long long invK = 1;
    long long base = k;
    long long exp = MOD - 2;
    // compute modular inverse of k using fast exponentiation
    long long inv = 1;
    long long b = base;
    long long e = exp;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) inv = (inv * b) % MOD;
        b = (b * b) % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return comb[n][k] = (res * inv) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> N >> K;
    vector<int> vals(N);
    for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) cin >> vals[i];
    for (int v : vals) {
        if (v == 50) fifty++;
        else if (v == 100) hundred++;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= 100; j++)
            comb[i][j] = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= fifty; j++)
            for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= hundred; j2++)
                for (int r = 0; r <= 10000; r++)
                    memo2[i][j][j2][r] = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++)
        for (int j = 0; j <= 50; j++)
            memo[i][j] = -1;
    int minSteps = calc(0, fifty, hundred);
    if (minSteps >= 1000000) {
        cout << -1 << "\n" << 0 << "\n";
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 50; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= 50; j++)
                for (int r = 0; r <= minSteps; r++)
                    memo2[0][i][j][r] = -1;
        cout << minSteps << "\n";
        cout << compute2(0, fifty, hundred, minSteps) << "\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
